brief:
Israeli occupation authorities are systematically broadening their use of incitement charges beyond individual arrests to control Palestinian educational institutions and consciousness, the Palestinian Prisoner's Club said, Shehab Wire reported. The rights group described the tactic as an expansion from a pretext for detention into a wider surveillance and control mechanism targeting individuals across schools and universities.

The move represents an escalation in authorities' efforts to suppress Palestinian institutional life and political expression through legal measures framed around incitement accusations.

title: Israel expands incitement charges against Palestinian schools and universities
